titulo: Swedish election: centre-left parties lead by just a single seat with most votes counted
cuerpo: Race too close to call and may take days to become clear despite early exit polls suggesting left bloc win With most of the votes counted, Sweden’s national election remained too close to call on Sunday night, with left-wing parties holding a lead of just a single seat according to a partial tally by the election authority. Earlier in the night, exit polls suggested that the country was on course for a brand new left-leaning government. But as the votes were counted, it was apparent it could take days for the outcome to become clear. Continue reading...
